@echo off
echo Restoring ISO Mounting and Virtual Drive Support...
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\bam" /v "Start" /t REG_DWORD /d "1" /f >nul 2>&1
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\dam" /v "Start" /t REG_DWORD /d "1" /f >nul 2>&1
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\cdrom" /v "Start" /t REG_DWORD /d "1" /f >nul 2>&1
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\cdfs" /v "Start" /t REG_DWORD /d "1" /f >nul 2>&1
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\udfs" /v "Start" /t REG_DWORD /d "1" /f >nul 2>&1
Powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-PnpDevice -FriendlyName 'Microsoft Virtual Drive Enumerator' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Enable-PnpDevice -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" >nul 2>&1
echo Virtual drives restored. Restart your PC.
pause
